notes:
• Tidier project panel: everything goes in one "Framelift" folder, with a
  folder per frame inside it. Layers added to an existing comp no longer get
  their own folder (their images go in the comp's Assets, or
  "Added to comps"). Older projects are tidied up on the next send.
• Frames with the same name are numbered: "Content Container (2)".
• Frames inside frames: a frame only becomes a precomp when its clipping
  actually hides something (content sticking out, or rounded corners).
  Far fewer nested precomps.
• The same picture is never imported twice: re-sends and other frames reuse
  the image already in the project (and on disk).
• New "Tidy project" button: removes Framelift precomps and images no comp
  uses any more, plus empty Framelift folders. Unused image files on disk move
  to "Figma assets/Unused (safe to delete)". Undoable.
• Readable layer names: Figma's default names ("Frame 427", "Rectangle 12")
  become "Image" or the words of the first text inside. Names designers set
  stay as they are.
• Precomps say which frame they belong to: "Card · Home screen".
• Automatic updates: the panel checks online for a new version when it opens,
  shows what's new, then downloads and installs it with one click.
  Nothing to set up.
